success.serialization: Exactly one text content item; text equals compact JSON of structuredContent; JSON-RPC id echoes request. Native structuredContent={ok:HTTP bool ok or true when absent/nonbool,data:entire HTTP Value}; isError=(ok==false). Original create/generate/list remove core ok/errors and appliedRules, lift nonempty appliedRules, put remaining core in data on ok:true; isError=(core ok!=true). Workspace success data retains complete core including ok/errors; failure data removes core ok/errors.

refusal.semantics: No automatic retries. InvalidInput => invalid_input/message "invalid input: {reason}"; Refused => server_refused/message "server refused request (HTTP {status})" (native error has status); Transport => transport/"server transport failed"; Protocol => protocol/"invalid server response"; OutcomeUnknown => outcome_unknown/"operation outcome unknown; reconcile server state before retrying". Native request(): POST5xx -> unknown before reading; other non2xx (including408) -> Refused; successful read/size/JSON failure -> unknown write, transport/protocol read. No HTTP error-body reflection in ordinary native tools. Original SDK special policy below.

httpStatuses.422: source/application NotCommitted errors exact code and errors; smtp_config_required or hosted_executor_unavailable conditional

refusal.authority: Current selected company and source admission, origin and protocol middleware may refuse before body or application. Service usage/business stages, where returned, retain actual scope and do not promise safe replay.
refusal.deliveryPolicy: POST email SDK: >=500 unknown; only200/409/422 read bounded JSON.200 requires ok:true and delivery object with accepted state (reconcile allows accepted/refused).409 preserves only ok:false/code delivery_unknown/delivery.state unknown;422 preserves only delivery_refused/refused. Malformed409 with delivery_unknown code => unknown; other mismatches Refused. Body read/oversize/invalid JSON always unknown. Known409/422 become native data envelope ok:false, not SDK error; status itself is not included. SMTP unknown remains unknown; reconciliation never calls transport; reviewed retry requires refused, exact source/message/state and current configured sender.

parseProtocol.transport: 1MiB UTF8 newline-delimited frames. Invalid JSON or missing newline -32700 id:null. Oversized frame responds then stderr message limit exceeded, exit1; ordinary request errors do not exit, EOF exit0. Config failures stderr exit2; runtime/serve failures stderr exit1; no stdout banners. Initialize then notifications/initialized; notifications never execute tools/respond. IDs string<=256 UTF8 bytes or signed64/unsigned64 integer, unique per session <=100000, sequential execution. Unknown method -32601, selected parser/global errors -32602. Params object; task presence always refused. Unknown outer request/params members otherwise ignored. Duplicate JSON names recursively last-value-win in Value before tools::call.
parseProtocol.argumentParsing: tools::call requires args.is_object before original dispatch and native dispatch. Original dispatch occurs BEFORE global year/account string guard. Native selected modules execute AFTER that guard: nonstring year/account => report selectors must be strings before deny_unknown_fields. Native structs reject unknown/null/missing fields (confirm is bool, false accepted by parser then refused by SDK); original confirm optional boolean, supplied null/nonbool RPC error, absent/false source CONFIRM_REQUIRED after shape validation. No public positional array even though Serde structs internally can deserialize sequences. Native company String parser accepts empty/non-slug then SDK rejects it (InvalidInput company must be a slug); advertised slug constraint is not the local parser. Original company extraction additionally rejects empty before SDK. Advertised confirm const true is not parser acceptance: native false reaches SDK validation.
parseProtocol.sdk: Before every HTTP dispatch negotiate /api/protocol; mismatch => protocol, no dependent operation. Exact origin/protocol1/current manifest/rust-http-v1; cookie OR service-key, no redirect/proxy inheritance, connect10s/total30s.16MiB JSON cap; response media-type not checked. No retry or TCP fallback for private Unix local profile; exact logical origin/private credential files required.

nativeHttpSerdeSequences.length: Exact declared tuple length, all Option positions required as null when absent; no missing/trailing positions. Root arrays refused by SDK and tools global object guard; only direct derived HTTP boundary supports these sequences. Nested original invoice is Value with explicit object/field validator, not a positional struct.

parseProtocol.nativeHttpHead: MCP uses GET/POST only. Direct HTTP: manual/original recurring list HEAD early405 Allow:GET before credentials/body; scheduled HEAD404 before Owner dispatch; hosted HEAD405; email HEAD status read not SMTP and may service-charge metadata. binary.semantics: No raw bytes/PDF or files in these MCP results. Generation verifies/creates immutable issued JSON/PDF internally, never returns binary; SMTP credentials/MIME not returned.

paginationFilterOrder.semantics: No cursor/offset/limit filters. Manual recurring templates id ascending, per-template generations period_index ascending. Workspace catalog slug ascending, skipped rows first then processed targets; missing generations template id/period ascending, cap maxGenerations default500 per company (1..5000), deliveries separately capped. Continuation reports counts, not retry authority.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No If-Match/revision parameter or key. Current canonical immutable template/state/plan hashes are operation-specific preconditions; server owns date/period/number/currency and exact source/PDF validation. Native source guards and installed extension state remain conditional, never fabricate a default or secret grant.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.authority: Human current verified session/MFA and live workspace/company rights; native manual, scheduled and hosted HTTP are human-cookie-only (service key rejected by proof). Original company recurring permits supported current service credentials via execute_service; email supports explicitly authorized service. Workspace requires current workspace owner cookie and exact configured workspace id/root assertion, never arbitrary filesystem selection. Current transfer/backup business-write fence and closed-period/source eligibility on issuance persist. Reads can write control usage/session metadata: not globally side-effect-free. Email writes require Fresh human session and CompanyExternalSend. Reservation commits, then fresh live authority/source checks before fixed SMTP handoff outside transactions, then recovery-only terminal recording. Service charges once and rechecks live principal/credential/current grants before handoff and recovery; revoked human/service cannot authorize fresh send, attempted unknown remains auditable, never safe resend signal.

key.meaning: No caller idempotency key supported. JSON-RPC id is session correlation only; messageId/templateId/period/stateHash/planHash are identity/preconditions, not generic replay keys.

retry.naturalDedup: Read projection only, not a keyed replay. Repeating reads may update usage/control metadata and observe newer state; never dispatches, reserves, posts or sends. Native scheduled list can refuse unsupported nonmanual source; successful read is not mutation permission.

readBack.semantics: After unknown stop and read authoritative same workspace/company ledger identity, exact template/period/document/PDF/hash/history, state/plan and delivery evidence. Canonical read does not post/send/reissue or authorize retry. Absence under changed authority/year/source/access or failed read is not noncommit proof; partial workspace results need per-company reconciliation and retained continuation before another explicit action.

retry.unresolvedProvider: SMTP handoff accepted only final250, definite4xx/5xx refused, ambiguous network/post-DATA/timeout unknown. Unknown reservation/history remains auditable even after revocation. Never automatically resend; status verifies stored original JSON/PDF/MIME; external evidence reconciliation does not send; only separate fresh authorized reviewed retry after definite nonacceptance. Accepted means SMTP acceptance, not inbox receipt/live-provider approval.
